purpose: Define read-only static APK discovery for JCC protocol/runtime hints without promoting candidates into live_state.
allowed_sources: adb pull installed APK files reported by pm path
local static string scanning of copied APK files
promotion_policy: Static APK hits are source_insights only. They may guide parser work, but never prove board_units, bench_units, local_chair_id, or current live_state without same-match runtime evidence and local binding verification.
pollution_guard: Never merge APK static candidates into live_state board_units or bench_units. Static terms can only explain schemas, message names, asset locations, or parser hypotheses.
